To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the governance of a blockchain network should be designed to balance the needs of the stakeholders and to provide a mechanism for resolving conflicts among stakeholders.

1) the design of a blockchain governance mechanism should be based on the needs of the community, and not the other way around; 2) the community should have an incentive to participate in the design and maintenance of the network; 3) the network should have a mechanism to resolve disputes between the different stakeholders; 4) the network should be able to adapt to changes in the environment; and 5) the network should not be too centralized.

blockchain governance can be understood by drawing on other theories of corporate governance, that the definition of stakeholders in a blockchain network is important, that the consensus mechanism determines the bargaining power among stakeholders in a network, and that exogenous governance mechanisms interact with institutional frameworks to determine the governance of a blockchain network.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: What are the governance mechanisms that can help a blockchain network grow?
the design of blockchain networks, and the implications of the design on the governance of the network.
the governance of blockchain networks, and how the design of blockchain networks can be informed by existing theories of governance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no one-size-fits-all solution to blockchain governance, and that a combination of on-chain and off-chain mechanisms is needed to ensure the sustainability of a blockchain network.
blockchain governance is complex.
there is no single model of governance that will work for all blockchain networks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
blockchain governance is a complex and evolving system.

the governance mechanisms of a blockchain are the rules by which the network is managed, and that these mechanisms are a function of the consensus mechanism, the institutional framework, the network’s stakeholders, and the network’s bootstrapping process.
blockchain governance mechanisms are complex and that there is a trade-off between decentralization and the ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
The main takeaway from our work is that
governance mechanisms should be designed in a way to maximize the incentives for all stakeholders to contribute to the network.
governance is an emergent phenomenon that is shaped by a complex interplay between the network’s design, the stakeholders’ expectations, and the institutional framework.
blockchain governance is a complex system that requires a holistic approach that takes into account both on chain and off chain factors.
